app.name: IFC-lite
app.one_liner: Parse, view, query, edit, and export IFC files in the browser using a Rust/WASM core and WebGPU rendering.

screens.name: Main Viewer
screens.purpose: Display loaded IFC models with interactive 3D navigation, entity selection, property inspection, and editing controls.

rust_commands.name: remove_entity
rust_commands.purpose: Remove an IFC entity from the model and clean up its associated GPU buffers and bounding box data.

rust_commands.name: translate_entity
rust_commands.purpose: Apply a positional delta to a specific IFC entity and update its rendered mesh in the WebGPU scene.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add translate/remove commands with mesh synchronization
week 1: Enable basic entity selection and property display
week 1: Integrate Rust/WASM IFC parser with WebGPU renderer
acceptance_tests: After translating an IFC entity, its rendered mesh updates immediately without requiring a full re-parse.
Removing an entity cleans up GPU memory and removes it from spatial queries.
The viewer loads and displays IFC2X3, IFC4, and IFC5 models without crashing.
